layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
Light: lit from the bottom left; faces turned to the left are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow.

Class: one empty ornamental picture frame for a spell icon in a game menu, seen straight on: a thick chunky border with a thick single-colour black outline, flat saturated colours with one shadow tone and one highlight, few details; the frame fills the whole square edge to edge and is the same on all four sides; its middle is a big empty hole showing the transparent background, nothing is drawn inside the hole.

Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 5 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a round frame ring made of bright green leaves woven around a green vine; (2) a round frame ring of shiny blue steel with four round silver rivets at the top, bottom, left and right; (3) a round frame ring of yellow brass shaped like a clock face rim with twelve dark tick marks; (4) a round frame ring of dark plum purple with four small silver crescent moons at the top, bottom, left and right; (5) a round frame ring of bright red with four jagged orange lightning-bolt spikes pointing outwards at the corners. The middle of every ring is an empty hole.
